statement: Let P = product_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i] be the exact mathematical integer product, not a 64-bit computation. Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = signFunc(P), where signFunc(x) = 1 if x > 0, signFunc(x) = -1 if x < 0, and signFunc(x) = 0 if x = 0. Equivalently: if some nums[i] = 0 then r = 0; otherwise r = 1 when the number of indices i with nums[i] < 0 is even, and r = -1 when that number is odd.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, array_sign(nums) returns a result r; it does not fail (no arithmetic overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r is one of -1, 0, or 1 (equivalently, -1 <= r <= 1 and r is not any other integer).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r with r = 0, there exists an index i such that 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: If there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = 0, then whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Assume every entry of nums is nonzero: for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] != 0. Let k be the number of indices i with nums[i] < 0. Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = 1 if k is even and r = -1 if k is odd.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: If len(nums) = 1, then whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = 1 if nums[0] > 0, r = -1 if nums[0] < 0, and r = 0 if nums[0] = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: If every entry of nums is positive (for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] > 0), then whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: If every entry of nums is negative (for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] < 0), then whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r, r = 1 when len(nums) is even and r = -1 when len(nums) is odd.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(nums2) returns a result r2, r = r2.
preconditions: Both nums and nums2 satisfy the problem constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, 1 <= len(nums2) <= 1000, every nums[i] and nums2[i] lies in [-100,100]; moreover len(nums) = len(nums2), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = 0 if and only if nums2[i] = 0, and nums[i] < 0 if and only if nums2[i] < 0.

statement: Let rev be the array of length len(nums) defined by rev[i] = nums[len(nums)-1-i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(rev) returns a result r_rev, r = r_rev.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let p be any bijection from {0,1,...,len(nums)-1} to itself, and let perm be the array defined by perm[i] = nums[p(i)] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(perm) returns a result r_perm, r = r_perm.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let neg be the array defined by neg[i] = -nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(neg) returns a result r_neg: if r = 0 then r_neg = 0; if r != 0 and len(nums) is even then r_neg = r; and if r != 0 and len(nums) is odd then r_neg = -r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every integer c with 1 <= c <= 100, let ext be the array with len(ext) = len(nums)+1, ext[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums), and ext[len(nums)] = c. Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(ext) returns a result r_ext, r = r_ext.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 999, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every integer c with -100 <= c < 0, let ext be the array with len(ext) = len(nums)+1, ext[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums), and ext[len(nums)] = c. Whenever array_sign(nums) returns a result r and array_sign(ext) returns a result r_ext: if r = 0 then r_ext = 0, and if r != 0 then r_ext = -r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 999, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let ext be the array with len(ext) = len(nums)+1, ext[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums), and ext[len(nums)] = 0. Whenever array_sign(ext) returns a result r_ext, r_ext = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 999, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.
